description: Spaces around a variadic_param string are ignored
notes: The README doesn't say how the variadic parameter's name is read. Read as a static traversal, whose string the JSON syntax reads as a native syntax expression (json/spec.md#static-traversal; see json/analysis/traversal-surrounding-spaces), spaces around the name are allowed, while a string that must be the name itself would be an error. hashicorp/hcl reads the name with hcl.ExprAsKeyword (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), for which the JSON syntax parses the string as a traversal ((*expression).AsTraversal in json/structure.go).
